label: Going There
description: Navigate a rocket through a 3×12 grid to the base in Grudziądz: dodge rocks using AI-interpreted radio hints and disarm OKO radar traps along the way.

steps.label: Start Game
steps.detail: Send 'start' command to hub; parse target row from response with LLM

steps.label: Scan Frequency
steps.detail: GET /api/frequencyScanner before each move; parse distorted JSON response

steps.label: Disarm Radar
steps.detail: Compute SHA1(detectionCode + 'disarm') and POST to neutralise OKO trap

steps.label: Radio Hint
steps.detail: POST /api/getmessage to receive rock position hint for the next column

steps.label: AI Navigation
steps.detail: LLM interprets nautical/directional hint and picks go/left/right avoiding the rock

steps.label: Reach Grudziądz
steps.detail: After 11 moves the rocket arrives at column 12, target row — hub returns flag
